proof:
by
  classical
  intro N inst w E bases fuel root
  induction fuel generalizing bases root with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
      by_cases h : 0 < root
      · simp only [M7.CompactGeneration.run, if_pos h, List.foldl_cons]
        exact ih _ _
      · simp [M7.CompactGeneration.run, h]
